select bcp.time_num, bcp.amount_cny, su.nick_name operation_name, bcp.remark, bc.course_name from bd_course_purchase bcp left join bd_course bc on bcp.course_id = bc.id left join sys_user su on su.user_id = bcp.create_by where student_id = #{studentId} and bcp.status = 1 order by bcp.create_time desc
, bcp.id desc
